description: This file defines functions and configurations for establishing asynchronous database sessions using SQLAlchemy with PostgreSQL. It includes URL parsing, environment variable handling, and session management for a backend application.

classes.name: AsyncSession
classes.description: Asynchronous SQLAlchemy session class for database interactions.

methods.name: _to_asyncpg_sqlalchemy_url
methods.description: Converts a PostgreSQL URL to an asyncpg-compatible SQLAlchemy URL.

methods.name: _read_db_url_from_connection_txt
methods.description: Reads a PostgreSQL URL from a db_connection.txt file.

methods.name: _discover_db_connection_txt
methods.description: Discovers the location of a db_connection.txt file in common directories.

methods.name: _build_db_url
methods.description: Builds the database connection URL based on environment variables and file discovery.
